steps.gate: Sequence cleared by S12 biosecurity screening before ordering. Order only on exit code 0 (cleared); 2 = blocked, 3 = not screened.

steps.note: Inducer addition yes; shaking incubation no.

steps.title: Ni-NTA (His-tag) purification
steps.note: Magnetic-bead His-tag format yes; gravity column/FPLC no.

steps.title: Quantify residual endotoxin (LAL)
steps.note: Plate setup yes; reading needs a plate reader.
steps.gate: Residual endotoxin below the release limit (NOT YET SET - decide before running) before ANY THP-1 work.

steps.title: Stimulate differentiated THP-1 with purified antigen
controls: endotoxin-matched LPS control (at the measured residual level)

steps.title: ELISA readout
steps.note: Plate setup and washes yes; reading no.

protocols.falsifier: At the in-vitro stage this candidate is falsified if EITHER (a) it cannot be expressed soluble and purified to the endotoxin limit, OR (b) the cytokine/transcript response does not exceed the endotoxin-matched LPS control and the polymyxin B-treated arm. A response explained by residual endotoxin is not evidence for the antigen.
does_not_measure: population HLA diversity (THP-1 is a single-genotype cell line)
protocols.estimate_basis: Durations are coarse engineering estimates, not measured; cost is unsourced.

steps.title: Order codon-optimised gene for Major outer membrane protein P.IA (porA)
steps.gate: Sequence cleared by S12 biosecurity screening before ordering. The S8 stage writes the order list (protein FASTA; the vendor back-translates it) to RUN_DIR/data/s8/order.fasta; check it with `python -m vaxforge.s12_biosafety check RUN_DIR/data/s8/order.fasta --run RUN_DIR --screening PROVIDER_RECORD.json` (PROVIDER_RECORD.json is the screening record from the synthesis provider). Order only on exit code 0 (cleared); 2 = blocked, 3 = not screened.

steps.title: Small-scale expression and induction
steps.note: Inducer addition yes; shaking incubation no.

steps.title: Ni-NTA (His-tag) purification
steps.note: Magnetic-bead His-tag format yes; gravity column/FPLC no.
steps.gate: Soluble protein recovered; if not, candidate falsified at expression (see falsifier).

steps.title: Quantify residual endotoxin (LAL)
steps.note: Plate setup yes; reading needs a plate reader.
steps.gate: Residual endotoxin below the release limit (NOT YET SET - decide before running) before ANY THP-1 work.

steps.title: Stimulate differentiated THP-1 with purified antigen
controls: endotoxin-matched LPS control (at the measured residual level)

steps.title: ELISA readout
steps.note: Plate setup and washes yes; reading no.

steps.title: RT QPCR readout
steps.note: Reaction setup yes; thermocycling and reading no.

protocols.falsifier: At the in-vitro stage this candidate is falsified if EITHER (a) it cannot be expressed soluble and purified to the endotoxin limit, OR (b) the cytokine/transcript response does not exceed the endotoxin-matched LPS control and the polymyxin B-treated arm. A response explained by residual endotoxin is not evidence for the antigen.
does_not_measure: population HLA diversity (THP-1 is a single-genotype cell line)
protocols.estimate_basis: Durations are coarse engineering estimates, not measured; cost is unsourced.

boltz.about: {"what": "Trimmed copy of a REAL stage-S7 payload (Boltz-2 2.2.1 on CPU with msa_mode 'empty', so no sequence left the machine; DiscoTope-3.0 on the Boltz models), for designing the structure screen.", "how_made": "On 2026-11-15 I re-ran S7 with the code on main plus the fix for issue #45 over a copy of my real 2026-11-14 run folder. The Boltz-2 models came from the content cache and are identical to the 2026-11-14 folds (same model sha256). Run in a plain run folder, so the outer envelope of the file was stream B's own; on main a RunStore run wraps this same payload in stream A's envelope (digest, producer, inputs as a dict).", "inputs": "a sample of the real N. meningitidis MC58 proteome (UniProt), not the 40-protein fixture. None of the three folded proteins is a Bexsero antigen.", "run_settings": {"s7.top_k": 3, "s7.boltz": {"msa": "empty", "accelerator": "cpu", "recycling_steps": 1, "sampling_steps": 50, "max_residues": 400}, "refdata.offline": true, "note": "recycling_steps 1 / sampling_steps 50 are fast smoke settings, not the defaults (3 / 200); pLDDT may be lower than a default run would give. These settings are not recorded inside analysis.folding."}, "validators": "esmfold and af2-no-msa were unavailable on this machine, so validator_agreement.value is null (n_validators 0).", "removed_to_keep_it_small": ["per-candidate: sequence, tcell, bcell, coverage, upstream", "payload: epitope_set, set_level_coverage, upstream", "candidates other than the 3 folded ones and 2 of the not_selected ones"], "not_in_the_artifact": "per-residue pLDDT. Only mean_plddt, the frac_* bands and n_residues_modelled are stored; the per-residue values are in the B-factor column of the PDB that structure.model_file points to (a run-folder file reference with sha256 and bytes; the PDB files are not committed).", "not_validation": "Confidence of a structural model says nothing about immunogenicity or protection (see payload.limits).", "correction": "This file replaces the first version (PR #44). Its structure.conformational_epitopes blocks were wrong: S7 had given DiscoTope pLDDT values 100 times too high (mean_plddt_input was 100 x mean_plddt and every below-floor count was 0). Fixed in issue #45; mean_plddt, the band fractions and structure_term were never affected."}
